QuestInfo.name: Manji's Mission
QuestInfo.0: #bAyan#k in the Tribal Refugee Camp has something to say about the #rsafety of the refugees#k.
QuestInfo.1: #bManji#k, in the #rSpirit Zone Limbo#k, has been the one keeping the Tribal Refugee Camp #bsafe#k. But Ayan is worried he's not eating properly. For Ayan's peace of mind, go #bsee how he's doing#k.
QuestInfo.2: You met #bManji#k in the #bSpirit Zone Limbo#k.

0.0: We've been safe all this time thanks to #bManji#k. He's been guarding the entrance to the Spirit Zone. He's a strong man, even if he's kind of gruff. I'm not sure he's been eating well, though...

yes.0: Thank you. #bManji#k is in the #bSpirit Zone Limbo#k.

no.0: Please visit #bManji#k, if you're not too busy...

0.1: Maybe you could go #bcheck in on him#k for me?
